human_cases.evidence_reference: No artwork survives. The former kit secretary took the crest files when he moved away, leaving only a parent's phone photo of the crest stitched on last season's home shirt. The numbering exists only as two marker on graph paper sheets, an alphabet and a digit set, drawn by a founding member in the nineties and photographed on a kitchen table. Last season's supplier back of shirt sheet is on hand as the format.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
